How to reinvent yourself
as a man in 6 months:

1. Rebuild your mornings:
The day follows the first hour.
• Same wake-up time
• No phone for 30 minutes
• Move before you scroll

2. Upgrade how you show up:
People read you before you speak.
• Clothes that fit
• Haircut every 4 weeks
• Stand up straight

3. Feed your mind daily:
A new man needs new ideas.
• One book a month
• One lesson a day
• One new topic a week
slides.texte_sophia:
3. Feed your mind daily:
A new man needs new ideas.
• One book a month
• One lesson a day on the Sophia app
• One new topic a week

slides.texte_overlay:
4. Show up for people:
Reinvention isn't hiding.
• Call one friend a week
• Keep every small promise
• Host one dinner a month
